verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes transactions to agents through the Transactions API, an OAuth-gated MCP server with transactions:read/write and accounting:read/write scopes, and the agent-mode CLI. The CLI's transactions commands include list/get/edit/missing/flag-missing/explain-missing/memo-suggestions, and the agents guide documents loading accounting and tracking categories, editing, and approving transactions, with every action landing in the audit log. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented 'uncoded transactions' filter (only missing receipts/memos is shown), an explicit agent workflow for proposing policy flags, a documented review queue for agent-proposed coding (as opposed to direct edits), and independent hands-on corroboration.
